cd /home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild && python3 -c "
import re,os,collections
root='.'
def path(m):
    return m.replace('.','/')+'.lean'
seen=set()
stack=['AlgebraicJacobian.RiemannRoch.FLVVanishing']
order=[]
missingfiles=[]
while stack:
    m=stack.pop()
    if m in seen: continue
    seen.add(m)
    p=path(m)
    if not os.path.exists(p):
        missingfiles.append(m); continue
    order.append(m)
    for line in open(p):
        mm=re.match(r'^import\s+(\S+)',line)
        if mm and mm.group(1).startswith('AlgebraicJacobian'):
            stack.append(mm.group(1))
print('closure size', len(order))
for m in sorted(order): print(m)
print('NOFILE', missingfiles)
"
